services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services in Peterborough
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full system installations, we handle every plumbing and heating challenge with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaking taps, and blocked drains fixed fast. We're on call 24/7 and aim to reach you within an hour of your call.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New Worcester, Ideal, and Baxi boilers installed with full certification. We handle the paperwork and help you access government grants.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Annual gas safe checks keep your boiler running safely and efficiently. Most faults diagnosed and repaired on the same day.

services.title: Heating System Installation
services.desc: Full central heating design and installation for new builds and upgrades. Radiators, pipes, and controls fitted to manufacturer standards.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Installation
services.desc: Complete suite fitting from pipework through to tiling. We coordinate every aspect so your new bathroom or kitchen works perfectly.

services.title: Leak Detection & Water Damage
services.desc: Hidden leaks found and fixed before they destroy your property. We use thermal imaging and pressure testing for accurate diagnosis.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Peterborough honest, fast plumbing without the cowboys.
about_para_1: DMV Plumbing & Heating was founded over 15 years ago by a Gas Safe registered engineer fed up with poor service and hidden charges across Peterborough. Today, we've completed over 2,000 jobs—from midnight burst pipes to full boiler replacements—and built our reputation on turning up on time, fixing the problem right, and charging a fair price.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we don't use scare tactics or upsell unnecessary work. Every engineer carries parts on the van, diagnoses faults honestly, and explains options clearly. We're a small, local team, not a call centre—when you ring, you speak to someone who knows your job.
reviews_heading: What Peterborough Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up at 2am to water pouring through the kitchen ceiling. Called DMV and they had someone here by 3am. Absolutely brilliant—Jake found the leak in the upstairs bathroom, capped it off temporarily, and came back the next morning to do the permanent fix. No messing about, fair price, and he even helped me clear up the water. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our old boiler die just before Christmas. I rang round three places and DMV gave the most honest quote. They installed a new Worcester unit the very next day, sorted all the paperwork for the grant application, and explained how to use the controls. Professional and friendly. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Caroline W.

reviews.text: Been using DMV for five years now. Never had to chase them or worry about hidden charges. They service the boiler every year, and when we needed a new radiator, they turned up when they said they would and finished the job neatly. Recommend them to everyone.
reviews.author: David K.
